newsitem.title: USA: Komag stock tumbles after profit warning, downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Komag stock tumbles after profit warning, downgrade.

text.p: The stock of Komag Corp. tumbled in heavy trading Tuesday, a day after the computer disk drive component maker warned of disappointing earnings.
The stock fell $5.375 or more than 16 percent to $27.75 on Nasdaq, where it was among the most active issues at midday.
PaineWebber Inc., which had previously rated the stock as attractive, downgraded it to neutral, market sources said.
The Milpitas, Calif.-based company said after the market closed Monday that its results for the fourth quarter ending Dec. 29 would be below expectations.

Komag said its earnings per share for the fourth quarter would be higher than the $16.5 million, or 31 cents a share, it reported in the third quarter, but below the 72 cents it posted in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company had sales of $131.5 million in the third quarter ended Sept. 29.
